existing_architecture_discovered.no_official_python_fabric_gateway_sdk: Confirmed via web search: only Go, Node.js, Java SDKs exist (github.com/hyperledger/fabric-gateway)
existing_architecture_discovered.database_schema: external_trust_anchors table (P5.11 ExternalTrustAnchorModel) already sufficient; no new table/migration added

fabric_gateway_client.transport: grpcio (no official Python Fabric Gateway SDK exists; justified per work-order constraint #12)
fabric_gateway_client.protocol_source: vendored, byte-for-byte unmodified .proto files from github.com/hyperledger/fabric-protos (main, Apache-2.0)
fabric_gateway_client.signing: ECDSA P-256/SHA-256, DER, low-S normalized (Fabric malleability-resistant convention)
fabric_gateway_client.tx_id_derivation: sha256(nonce(24 random bytes) || creator_bytes) hex, standard Fabric client construction

exceptions_added.naming_note: FabricNotConfigured/FabricUnavailable do not end in 'Error' per explicit work-order naming; not renamed for a lint preference

new_endpoint.mechanism: connection-level TLS/gRPC channel-ready probe; never submits a chaincode transaction

retry_policy.submit_transaction: no retry; single attempt, raises immediately on any failure to avoid duplicate on-chain writes
retry_policy.evaluate_transaction_connect_health_chec: no automatic retry either; conservative policy per work-order Phase 8

testing_strategy.fake_gateway_server: intelligence/device_ai/tests/fabric_test_server.py — in-process TLS gRPC server implementing the real gateway.Gateway service contract, compiled from the same vendored unmodified protos as the client
does_not_validate: MSP/identity membership validation by a real peer
testing_strategy.chaincode_simulation: minimal stateful AnchorDevicePassport/GetDeviceAnchor replica in the fake server for round-trip trust-evaluation tests; records writes at Endorse time (simplification, documented)

fabric_live_network_status.reason: No live Hyperledger Fabric network exists in this repository or execution environment. blockchain/network/, blockchain/fabric-network/, blockchain/scripts/ are empty, pre-existing placeholder directories (dated 2026-07-20, predating P6.1). No docker-compose file anywhere defines a Fabric peer/orderer/CA.
fabric_live_network_status.marker_omission_reason: No runnable live-network target exists in this environment; adding an unusable marker would be a hollow gesture rather than honest documentation
fabric_live_network_status.mocked_fabric_e2e: PASS (via in-process fake Gateway server, real TLS/gRPC/protobuf/signing round trip)

security_considerations: No secrets committed; .gitignore hardened for *.key, *.pem, *.p12, *.pfx, wallet/, credentials/, crypto-config/
No real certificate/key material ever created in the repository; only ephemeral tmp_path self-signed test identities generated fresh per test run
Logging never includes certificate/key contents; verified by dedicated tests
TLS is mandatory; no insecure-channel fallback
ECDSA signatures normalized to low-S form (Fabric malleability-resistant convention)
limitations: No live Fabric network validation — the single largest gap (endorsement policy, MSP validation, real chaincode execution, commit atomicity all unverified against a genuine peer)

Two independent FabricGatewayClient instances can exist per process (ledger's own + health-endpoint singleton), each opening its own gRPC channel — deliberate per existing build_X/get_X convention, minor inefficiency
FABRIC_CONNECTION_PROFILE/FABRIC_DISCOVERY_ENABLED accepted but unused (direct single-peer connection only)
ChaincodeSpec.type set to GOLANG placeholder even though chaincode is TypeScript (standard practice across Fabric SDKs; peer ignores it)
No automatic retry anywhere (deliberate conservative choice, not a gap)
fabric_test_server.py's chaincode simulation records writes at Endorse time, not gated on CommitStatus result (documented simplification)
